name: voice_comfort
title: Voice comfort
summary: Makes Mary's voice slower, faster, quieter or louder, and switches between Mary and Sam.
instructions: Use when they ask you to talk slower, faster, quieter or louder, or to switch between Mary and Sam. The resident can't use their hands well, so do these when asked by voice. Then ask if that is better.

actions.name: slower
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little slower.

actions.name: faster
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little faster.

actions.name: quieter
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little quieter.

actions.name: louder
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little louder.
